full_judgment: 3. Plaintiffs' case, in short, was that the suit land originally belonged to Shachi Prosonnya Mukhaopadhoya and others. By amicable arrangement, Shanti Prosonnya and his mother Kamalakshmi Devi got the same. They settled the same to the predecessor-in-interest of the plain-tiff-appellants by a patta dated 09.07.1955 who took such settlement in the name of the defendant No. 4 and got delivery of possession of the said land. In S.A operation, the nature of the land was recorded as OevIo01 inasmuch as the plaintiff-appellants' names were rightly recorded in S.A. Khatian Nos. 530, 267 and 741. Thereafter, the Government initiated the disputed proceedings. Hence, the case.
